::: {#thm-double-negation}
#### Double negation

For a proposition $P$, $\neg \neg P \equiv P$ (@def-logical-equivalence).

:::

::: {.content-hidden when-format="revealjs"}

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: proof

| $P$ | $\neg P$ | $\neg \neg P$ |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| T | F | T |
| F | T | F |

The first and last columns match in both rows.

:::

:::
